test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**as**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase ***"His ambition was not fulfilled as his parents did not agree"*** indicates a causal relationship between the man's unfulfilled ambition and his parents' disagreement. The word "**as**" is used **to introduce a reason or cause in this context,** making it the most appropriate **option to fill in blank 3.**
 
• Meaning of other options:
 
 
• **Any**: *"His ambition was not fulfilled any his parents did not agree" *doesn't make sense grammatically or contextually. The word "**any**" is not suitable in this sentence structure.
 
• **Thus**: *"His ambition was not fulfilled thus his parents did not agree" *doesn't fit well in the context. "**Thus**" typically indicates a conclusion or result, but it doesn't effectively convey the causal relationship between the two parts of the sentence.
 
• **While**: *"His ambition was not fulfilled while his parents did not agree"* suggests a temporal relationship rather than a causal one. It implies that the man's ambition was not fulfilled at the same time that his parents did not agree, which doesn't convey the intended meaning of why his ambition was not fulfilled. 

 
 
 

Correct Passage:__ *A man is not bad by birth but circumstances make him bad. He was a kind man and wanted to join a travelling circus. His ambition was not fulfilled **as** his parents did not agree. He held his family and society (4)________ for the frustration of his dreams. Therefore, he became (5)_______ with everyone.*
